portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: civica.loader.js, Civica.APIUrl bootstrap and a keyobjectviewer widget on the application summary page

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. The same Modern.gov install also lists Lewes District Council committees. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: A bare six-digit number: two-digit year followed by a four-digit serial, with no prefix or type suffix.

browser_route.note: The application summary page with its documents list.

endpoints.note: Reference-keyed, so no search call is needed: POST doc/list with JSON {"KeyNumb":0,"KeyText":"<REF>","RefType":"APPPlanCase","ProcessNo":"","PageSize":50} -> CompleteDocument[] and RowCount, then GET pagestream per DocNo.

quirks.summary: Eastbourne applications are on this Civica register, not on the Idox install at planningpa.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk.
quirks.detail: A received-date search on the Idox install for 1-7 August 2026 returned only Lewes (LW/) and tree (TW/) references, while PlanIt's Eastbourne records for the same weeks point at this Civica page with six-digit references.
quirks.workaround: Use the Civica API with the six-digit reference.

quirks.summary: The API is on a different host (gtest.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk) from the page (www.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk).
quirks.detail: The host name reads like a test server, but it is the Civica.APIUrl that the live summary page uses. It is also a different host from the Lewes document store (padocs.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk).
quirks.workaround: Read Civica.APIUrl from the page rather than assuming the page host.

quirks.summary: doc/list rows carry the uploading officer's user id alongside each document.
quirks.workaround: Keep only DocNo, DocDesc, DocDate and FileName.

pacing.note: Four requests across the page and API hosts at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26, no 429 or challenge. The page host is behind Cloudflare (passive at the time).

robots.note: www.lewes-eastbourne.gov.uk/robots.txt disallows only /licensing-a-z/. The API host returned HTTP 500 for robots.txt.

verification.note: PlanIt's Eastbourne applics records pointed at the Civica summary page with RefType=APPPlanCase&KeyText=<ref>. The page was fingerprinted as Civica and its bootstrap gave the cross-host API. doc/list for 260415 in the reference-keyed form -> RowCount 16 (16 rows; PlanIt n_documents 15) -> pagestream download: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7 magic bytes. The shared Lewes Idox search was also run for 1-7 August 2026 and held no Eastbourne references. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id. Content check on a full download: 251,297 bytes, 2 pages with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice.
